messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
There's a thing in coalition banks where personal balance is included in the bank balance.

This means the alliance can withdraw what you put in for yourself. Obviously, this is a terrible idea

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text: extra pics. personal balance is added to bank balance

messages.author: luciuskonst
messages.text: they NEED to be separate pools

messages.author: luciuskonst
messages.text: otherwise there is no certainty about what the alliance bankers can use, and what 'belongs' to individuals

messages.author: luciuskonst
messages.text: there are all sorts of security issues with a mixed pool as well, like how it's possible for people to only deposit to their personal, while only taking alliance grants, thereby allowing them to withdraw in excess of their actual deposits at a whim

messages.author: luciuskonst
messages.text: We'll also need 2 types of withdrawals (grant, and personal withdrawal) and 2 types of deposits (donation, and personal deposit) to fix the banking system

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text: we going back to dns with this one 🗣️

messages.author: luciuskonst
messages.text: (but yes, the dns banking system was genuinely good)

title: Separate personal balances from bank balances.
